title: Graduate econometrics notes
text:
Archived course materials · Spring 2016 · ← teachingThese materials are archived from Spring 2016 and are retained because they continue to be useful as econometrics references.
I served as the GSI for Max Auffhammer’s first-year PhD econometrics course, ARE 212, in Spring 2016. I built these notes off of material from Dan Hammer, Patrick Baylis, and Kenny Bell. I’ve created some sections from scratch and expanded others, so there are likely mistakes remaining (caveat econometricus). If you find one, let me know!

title: fiona burlig
text:
I am Fiona Burlig, an assistant professor at the Harris School of Public Policy at the University of Chicago. I am an applied microeconomist working at the intersection of energy, environmental, and resource economics and development economics, with a particular focus on energy, water, and climate adaptation.

Faculty Research Fellow, NBER (EEE and DEV) · Affiliate, J-PAL, BREAD, and IGC · Deputy Faculty Director, EPIC-India and the Odisha Data, Policy, and Innovation Centre

title: PPHA 34600: Program evaluation (2020)
text:
Archived course materials · Spring 2020 · ← teaching
I teach MPP-level program evaluation at the University of Chicago in the spring quarter.
The class is split into three sections, each with a distinct topical focus. Section 1 has a general applied micro focus. Section 2 has an international development focus. Section 3 has an energy and environment focus. The below materials are broken out into sections where applicable.
Due to the COVID-19 pandemic, I conducted the course entirely online. My course materials, including syllabi, lecture slides, and pre-recorded videos can be found here. PDFs are broken out by section where applicable. There are definitely mistakes remaining (caveat econometricus). If you find one, let me know!
